title: Simple drawer tray generator
lastAssistantText:
All checks pass. The deliverable is complete and verified.

## Summary

Built a single self-contained offline `index.html` (24 KB, zero external dependencies) — a drawer-organizer tray maker.

**Features delivered:**
- **Editable parameters**: outer Width/Depth/Height (mm), Columns/Rows grid, Wall thickness, Floor thickness — all with live updates.
- **Clear compartment readout**: live display of per-compartment clear width × depth × height (interior cavity with walls + dividers subtracted) plus compartment count. Defaults compute to **55 × 53.75 × 27.5 mm**, 6 compartments.
- **Rotatable 3D preview**: custom minimal WebGL renderer (hand-written mat4/persp/lookAt + flat-shaded box mesh). Drag to rotate, scroll/pinch to zoom, auto-rotate toggle, optional wireframe overlay. Fixed the camera so the tray's **height rises vertically** (world-Z = up) rather than lying on its side.
- **Printable STL export**: watertight binary STL (floor + 4 walls + dividers as boxes → 12 triangles each), with outward-facing unit normals, little-endian per spec. Filename encodes dimensions and grid.
- Starts at **180 × 120 × 30 mm, 3 × 2 grid** as specified.

**Bugs caught and fixed during verification** (I ran the geometry/STL math in Node since the sandbox restricted `/tmp` and had no browser):
1. STL emitted only **1 triangle per face** (non-watertight) → fixed to 2 triangles/face.
2. `setFloat32` called on a `Uint8Array` instead of the `DataView` → would have written garbage.
3. STL header text written at **offset 80**, colliding with the facet-count field and misaligning all facet data → moved header to offset 0.
4. Model matrix applied an extra `+W/2,+D/2` translation on already-world-space vertices → set to identity.
5. Camera `up`/target swapped depth & height axes → tray now orients correctly.

**Verification performed:** JS syntax check, watertight/facet-count checks across 4 configs, outward-normal validation, full binary-STL format validation (header/count/stride/endianness), and an end-to-end integration test that wrote and re-read a real `.stl` file (96 facets, all unit normals). All passed. Test scaffolding removed; only `index.html` remains as the deliverable.

Open `index.html` in any modern browser — no server or internet needed.
